rationale.problem: The render sandbox captures a fixed viewport, while the locked upstream authoring reference mandates a 1920x1080 stage. A composition that followed the reference rendered as the empty top-left corner of its own stage: 180 byte-identical frames encoded into a valid MP4 that was a still image. Neither the authoring gates nor the render sandbox could observe the disagreement, because neither knew the other's number.
rationale.resolution: The capture viewport is one declared value read by every side. The authoring gate rejects any composition whose declared stage differs from it, so the mismatch fails before a browser is launched rather than after an MP4 exists.
rationale.changing: Raising the canvas means changing this file and the sandbox spec together; the still-frame gate in the render job is the backstop that keeps a future mismatch loud.
